description: Capability for the MAIN window only. Grants core APIs, the opener plugin, native file dialogs (open/save), and the filesystem plugin's default set only (app-specific-dir read/mkdir defaults — no additional fs permissions). All file I/O (open/save/save-as, paste-image writes, image/PDF reads) goes through Rust IPC commands that use std::fs DIRECTLY (not the fs plugin), so it bypasses this capability entirely — tightening to user-chosen paths only requires a deeper per-action grant model and is tracked as a future production gate. DELIBERATELY grants no $HOME-scoped fs plugin access: the main webview renders AI markdown and remote images, so this contains the blast radius of a compromised webview (even if XSSed, it has no frontend-exposed fs read/write outside app-specific dirs). Tauri's deny-default protections (e.g. the webview data folder on Windows/Linux) still take precedence. See README 'Security' section. The settings window has its own reduced capability (capabilities/settings.json).
